description: The full End of Session report for ONE shift: sales, taxes, settlement, refunds, staff sales, tips and the cash drawer. Answers 'does the drawer balance', 'was the till short last night', 'what did that shift take'. Takes the session id from get_sessions, never a station or a person. The cash drawer section is what tells you over / short — report it plainly, and do not compute it yourself from the other sections.
name: hub_get_session_report
title: End of session report
